why_ai: Fans and sponsors pay for specific human players and teams competing, which AI cannot substitute.
why_clarity: Match results are clear, but the sponsored product, audience attention, has no agreed measure.
why_digital: Games, streams and clips are digital, with live events, bootcamps and merchandise in person.

why_ai: Aggregating platform metrics and attributing attention is analytics work AI-native tools take over.
why_clarity: Each surface reports incompatible units, so the deliverable lacks an agreed definition.
why_digital: Platform viewership data in, audience reports out, sold remotely.

why_ai: Integration and normalisation of platform data is plumbing software builds without people.
why_clarity: Normalisation steps are codifiable and recur, though the unit itself is still being defined.
why_digital: Data from streams and social platforms in, a single metric out.

why_ai: Fans keep buying physical identity goods, but forecasting, drops and store operations automate.
why_clarity: Sales per drop are measured instantly and the drop cycle repeats.
why_digital: Online global storefront, but the product is physical goods printed and shipped.

why_ai: Multi-year contract bets on transfer of skill across teams and metas are high-stakes and ambiguous.
why_clarity: Player contribution depends on patch, role and teammates, and only shows a season later.
why_digital: In-game statistics drive analysis, while signings run through tryouts and agent relationships.

why_ai: Coach relationships decide who replies, but matching and scheduling are automatable.
why_clarity: Frequent, similar scheduling tasks whose success is visible immediately.
why_digital: Arranged in online chats and played as online practice matches.

why_ai: Requires a data-sharing relationship with sponsors and causal judgment across an organisational boundary.
why_clarity: Sponsor outcomes depend on data the organisation cannot see, so results are slow and partial.
why_digital: Attention and sponsor data analysed on screen, sold into sponsor relationships.

why_ai: Partnership directors win deals through relationships and negotiation on inventory nobody can value.
why_clarity: Pricing is by precedent and negotiation, though a signed or renewed deal is clear.
why_digital: Decks and spreadsheets on screen, but inventory includes jerseys and appearances, sold in meetings.

why_ai: Visas, travel, team houses and player welfare need a person on the ground when things fail.
why_clarity: A visa arriving or a flight booked is checkable, but each event's logistics differ.
why_digital: Work centres on people, travel and housing delivered physically across countries.

why_ai: Clipping, formatting and scheduling across platforms is what AI video tools already automate.
why_clarity: High-volume repetitive clips with engagement metrics returned within hours.
why_digital: Streams in, clips posted to online platforms out.

why_ai: Young players need trusted advocates for health, contracts and transition, a relationship-based service.
why_clarity: Whether a career was survivable and the exit successful is known only years later.
why_digital: Concerns players' bodies, contracts and lives, served partly remotely across a global roster.
